decisive_items: FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene positive on RT-PCR
response.rationale: The presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene is a specific diagnostic marker for Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia, distinguishing it from other eosinophilic disorders.

rejected.why: Elevated tryptase is not exclusive to mastocytosis and can be seen in other conditions.
While hypereosinophilia is present, it is not specific enough to diagnose Eosinophilic Disorder without considering other findings.
Histiocytosis is considered but the presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene and significant eosinophilia points more strongly towards Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia.
